_comment: Which per-framework guides exist, keyed by the feature names `bridge guide <framework> <feature>` takes (the file stems under mcp/ in each plugin repo). The one copy: `bridge guide list` reads it from the package, and the Bridge MCP server reads it from GitHub (bridge-cli/main/bridge-cli/prompts/guide-coverage.json). Update it when a plugin adds or removes an mcp/*-prompt.md. `topics` lists the framework-agnostic guides bundled here (`bridge guide <topic>`).

topics.orientation: What Bridge does: a short map to relay to the developer (bridge guide orientation)
topics.fit-together: How roles, plans, limits and flags fit together: the rule every decision guide builds on (bridge guide fit-together)
topics.mechanisms: How limits, the upgrade dialog and page customisation work (bridge guide mechanisms)
